About.title: About Me
About.greeting: Hi, I'm Maurizio Compagnone, a computer science student passionate about books, cinema, and videogames. My true passion is anything that combines creativity and technology at all its levels.
About.p2: I enjoy assembling fully customised PCs and mechanical keyboards since there is something deeply satisfying about seeing separate components becoming something functional and unique, with its own character.
About.p3: I am curious by nature and I like to understand how various things work, not just superficially. Whether it's taking apart a device, reading technical documentation, or programming a website, I always try to seek the balance between practicality and aesthetics.
